name: aws_storagegateway_gateway
description: Hybrid cloud storage service connecting on-premises environments with AWS cloud storage

gateway_timezone.name: gateway_timezone
gateway_timezone.description: Time zone for the gateway (e.g., GMT, GMT-5:00, GMT+2:00)

activation_key.name: activation_key
activation_key.description: Gateway activation key (conflicts with gateway_ip_address). Required if gateway_ip_address not set

gateway_ip_address.name: gateway_ip_address
gateway_ip_address.description: Gateway IP address for activation (conflicts with activation_key)

gateway_vpc_endpoint.name: gateway_vpc_endpoint
gateway_vpc_endpoint.description: VPC endpoint address for private connectivity to Storage Gateway

medium_changer_type.name: medium_changer_type
medium_changer_type.description: Type of medium changer (VTL gateways only)

tape_drive_type.name: tape_drive_type
tape_drive_type.description: Type of tape drive (VTL gateways only)

cloudwatch_log_group_arn.name: cloudwatch_log_group_arn
cloudwatch_log_group_arn.description: ARN of CloudWatch log group for error logging

smb_guest_password.name: smb_guest_password
smb_guest_password.description: Guest password for SMB file shares (FILE_S3 and FILE_FSX_SMB only)

smb_security_strategy.name: smb_security_strategy
smb_security_strategy.description: Security strategy for SMB (FILE_S3 and FILE_FSX_SMB only)

smb_file_share_visibility.name: smb_file_share_visibility
smb_file_share_visibility.description: Whether to make file shares visible in Network Neighborhood (FILE_S3 only)

average_download_rate_limit_in_bits_per_.name: average_download_rate_limit_in_bits_per_sec
average_download_rate_limit_in_bits_per_.description: Average download bandwidth rate limit in bits per second

average_upload_rate_limit_in_bits_per_se.name: average_upload_rate_limit_in_bits_per_sec
average_upload_rate_limit_in_bits_per_se.description: Average upload bandwidth rate limit in bits per second

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the gateway
